newsitem.title: USA: AMNEX to buy back pfd stk, redeem debt.
newsitem.headline: AMNEX to buy back pfd stk, redeem debt.

text.p: AMNEX Inc said Wednesday it had signed agreements to buy back and cancel convertible preferred shares and redeem convertible debt held by clients of Friedli Corporate Finance AG.

Allan Rossi, recently named chairman and chief executive officer of AMNEX, said in an interview that the redemption was part of a plan designed to simplify the company's capital structure and strengthen its balance sheet.
This wil make it easier to seek financing and pursue growth strategies, he said.
AMNEX said it is also pursuing an additional receivables financing facility and is in discussions with several commercial banks.

It said Francesco Galesi, a director of the company, has reached an agreement to buy 80.8 percent of the company's 10 percent notes payable worth $404,000 with $126,000 of accrued interest from Friedli clients.

Galesi will convert the notes into 2.6 million AMNEX common shares, subject to a one-year lock-up. The balance of the company's notes, $96,000 principal and about $29,000 in accrued interest, will be converted by holders into about 625,000 common shares, also subject to a one-year lock-up.
In addition. Galesi has loaned AMNEX $2 million at 10 percent interest to provide interim working capital while the company arranges the receivables financing facility, the company said.
Galesi received a warrant to buy 500,000 common shares at $2.3125 each, it said. The warrant is not exercisable before June 3, 1999, it said.
As of May 31, Galesi owned 1.5 million AMNEX common shares and a warrant to buy 1.5 million additional shares.
